shellCommands.command: git status --short && cat package.json && ls -la && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100
for f in next.config.ts app/*.tsx __agent_eval__/run.mjs tsconfig.json; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; echo; done; git diff package.json
npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | head -20; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40
ls .next/server/app/ && sed -e 's/<script[^>]*>[^<]*<\/script>//g' .next/server/app/index.html | grep -o '<body.*' | head -c 3000; echo; git status --short; git diff tsconfig.json
git checkout -- tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && cat .gitignore && git status --short
